description: 必要导航补充登记后执行预算内2个固定原对象GET，保存目录锚点后才决定同3月原文；不换月份/省级或拼单月，不改源码。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import requests,json,hashlib,time
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urljoin
ROOT=Path.cwd();REL='reports/research/510300_electricity_physical_quantity_source_qualification_v1';OUT=ROOT/REL
assert not (OUT/'原公开收件_前两对象.json').exists(),'固定前两对象收件已执行，不重试。'
proto=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
amend=json.loads((OUT/'02_同三月原文目录导航路由补充登记.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert amend['total_public_raw_gets_at_most']==proto['budget']['public_raw_gets_at_most']==3
raw=OUT/'raw';raw.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def fetch(item):
 t0=time.monotonic();r={**item,'requested_at':now(),'method':'GET','authenticated':False,'redirects_enabled':False,'attempt':1}
 s=requests.Session();s.trust_env=False
 try:
  resp=s.get(item['url'],headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0','Accept':'text/html'},timeout=(10,25),allow_redirects=False)
  data=resp.content;p=raw/(item['object_id']+'.html');p.write_bytes(data)
  r.update({'received_at':now(),'http_status':resp.status_code,'response_url':resp.url,
   'content_type':resp.headers.get('Content-Type'),'response_date':resp.headers.get('Date'),
   'raw_path':str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
   'status':'RAW_RESPONSE_SAVED' if resp.status_code==200 else 'HTTP_NON200_SAVED','elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-t0,
   'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False})
 except Exception as e:r.update({'received_at':now(),'status':'REQUEST_FAILED_NO_RETRY','error_type':type(e).__name__,'error':str(e),'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-t0})
 finally:s.close()
 return r
items=[
 {'object_id':'official_news_catalogue','object_role':'固定3月原文导航','url':amend['fixed_directory_url'],'selected_from':'turn633search7'},
 {'object_id':'national_electricity_2024_01_02','object_role':'固定1/2月搜索实际定位的全国合并发布','url':'https://www.nea.gov.cn/2024-03/20/c_1310768302.htm','selected_from':'turn633search0'}]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:receipts=list(pool.map(fetch,items))
obj={'study_id':proto['study_id'],'recorded_at':now(),'public_search_queries':2,'raw_official_gets':2,
 'authenticated_provider_requests':0,'receipts':receipts,'raw_get_budget_remaining':1,
 'route_amendment':'02_同三月原文目录导航路由补充登记.json'}
(OUT/'原公开收件_前两对象.json').write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
catalogue=receipts[0];links=[]
if catalogue.get('http_status')==200:
 soup=BeautifulSoup((ROOT/catalogue['raw_path']).read_bytes(),'html.parser')
 for a in soup.find_all('a',href=True):
  title=a.get_text(' ',strip=True)
  if '3月份全社会用电量同比增长7.4%' in title:
   links.append({'title':title,'url':urljoin(catalogue['url'],a['href']),'anchor_html':str(a),
     'catalogue_raw_sha256':catalogue['sha256']})
 links=list({x['url']:x for x in links}.values())
(OUT/'目录中固定三月原文锚点.json').write_text(json.dumps(links,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
for r in receipts:print(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False))
print('同三月原文锚点',json.dumps(links,ensure_ascii=False))
